name: VOD Failover
description: When a VOD stream fails to start on one provider account (e.g. HTTP 458 connection limit, 404, timeout), retries the same title on the next account that carries it, and remembers the failure so later requests go straight to a working account. Also shows and edits the M3U Failover proxy's mirror URLs.
author: Brxdy22

fields.label: Remember failures for (minutes)
fields.help_text: How long a failed account/stream is skipped for that title (404s, timeouts, server errors).
fields.description: How long a failed account/stream is skipped for that title (404s, timeouts, server errors).

fields.label: Remember connection-limit errors for (seconds)
fields.help_text: 458/429 'max connections' errors are usually the provider still counting a just-closed connection.
fields.description: 458/429 'max connections' errors are usually the provider still counting a just-closed connection.

fields.label: Free busy accounts by cancelling unwatched Streamcache downloads
fields.help_text: When every account carrying a title is at capacity, cancel Streamcache background downloads that have no viewers, then retry.
fields.description: When every account carrying a title is at capacity, cancel Streamcache background downloads that have no viewers, then retry.

fields.label: Streamcache URL (as seen from Dispatcharr)
fields.help_text: Used only to list and cancel unwatched downloads.
fields.description: Used only to list and cancel unwatched downloads.

fields.label: Max attempts per request
fields.help_text: Total upstream attempts (including the first) before giving up on a request.
fields.description: Total upstream attempts (including the first) before giving up on a request.

fields.label: Mirror URLs (M3U Failover)
fields.description: Only for accounts that use the M3U Failover proxy. The VOD failover above works without it.

fields.label: M3U Failover address
fields.help_text: Host of the M3U Failover proxy as seen from Dispatcharr. Accounts whose Server URL points at it are listed.
fields.description: Host of the M3U Failover proxy as seen from Dispatcharr. Accounts whose Server URL points at it are listed.

fields.label: Mirror list
fields.placeholder: Press Load Mirror List, then reopen this page.
fields.help_text: Edit, press Save, then Apply Mirror List. One [section] per account, then its URLs in order of preference. Sections left out are not changed. The nightly sort may reorder them again.
fields.description: Edit, press Save, then Apply Mirror List. One [section] per account, then its URLs in order of preference. Sections left out are not changed. The nightly sort may reorder them again.

actions.label: Check Hook Status
actions.description: Show whether the failover hooks are installed and how many failures are remembered.

actions.label: Clear Remembered Failures
actions.description: Forget all remembered failures so every account is tried again.

actions.label: Mirror Status
actions.description: Show which mirror URL each proxied account uses, pauses, resting URLs and the last sort.

actions.label: Load Mirror List
actions.description: Copy the proxy's current URL lists into the Mirror list box. Reopen this page to see them.

actions.label: Apply Mirror List
actions.description: Send the saved Mirror list to the proxy. It writes upstreams.conf and uses the new order at once.

actions.label: Sort Mirrors Now
actions.description: Run the nightly sort now: a few spaced logins per URL, then fastest and most reliable first.
